descriptionHtml: "Career Ascend: Your Path to Professional Success," featuring Mr. Dhammika Marasinghe, successfully concluded with over 100 participants. Attendees gained invaluable insights on crafting the perfect CV, understanding industry expectations, and mastering LinkedIn for job searching and networking. The session equipped participants with the knowledge to create standout CVs, optimize LinkedIn profiles, and understand the skills needed for career success. This event was a significant step towards professional growth and effective networking.
